children: Western Digital announced the redemption of all outstanding $109,505,000 of 3.00% convertible senior notes due 2028, scheduled for Nov. 16, 2026.
Will redeem $109,505,000 aggregate principal of 3.00% convertible notes at 100% of principal plus accrued interest.
Redemption Date set for November 16, 2026; interest through Nov. 15, 2026 paid separately and not included in redemption price.
Holders may convert notes through Nov. 12, 2026; current conversion rate is 26.5231 shares per $1,000 principal.
Company elected a 0% cash percentage for conversions — will pay cash up to principal and settle remaining in common stock.
No settlement or modification to related capped call transactions is anticipated in connection with the redemption.
